title: Stretching for a Supernatural Breakthrough
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner preaches on the theme of "stretching" and how God is expanding the lives of His people, making room for more blessings, favor, and anointing. Listen as Pastor Zehner shares the vision for The River Church of Kansas City and calls believers to stretch out in faith, yielding to the Holy Ghost and trusting in God's promise of breakthrough and explosion. This sermon will inspire and equip you to live a life of faith and expectation, knowing that God is making room for more in your life.
